notes.title: In the game demo appeared official voice acting!
notes.content: [p]As always, we're a little late, but anyway.[/p][p]Meet the demo of [b]Kami: Parade of Senses ver. 0.3[/b]. We hope this update will be the last one and the next big news will be about the game itself.[/p][p]New features:[/p][olist][*][p]Now you can not only see the characters, but also hear them thanks to the hard work of the Hatoshi voice team.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now listen to songs by the band Octavian Serpen on the radio. Well... one song for now :)[/p][/*][*][p]We corrected mistakes in the text and added some missing phrases.[/p][/*][/olist]
